data.what_it_does: Provides XDG theme icons for Flutter applications, allowing you to render standard desktop icons like the 'computer' icon with customized sizes.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application for Linux and want to use native XDG theme icons
You need standard desktop icon sets in your UI
avoid_when: You are building mobile-only apps without desktop integration requirements
You need an extensive cross-platform icon pack like FontAwesome or Material Symbols
strengths: Integrates standard XDG theme icons into Flutter
Uses jovial_svg to support SVG styles
weaknesses: Platform support is primarily focused on Linux plugins
Limited to XDG theme icon specifications

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a vast collection of icons available across all platforms rather than Linux XDG theme icons.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer consistent, clean vector icons for your UI across platforms.

alternatives.name: material_symbols_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want access to Google's official Material Symbols.
